blocks.html:
A focused Fountain apparel brief

Custom apparel for Fountain and the south-corridor project

Fountain custom-apparel requests can include local-business identity, community and family events, group shirts, practical staff garments, and new merchandise ideas. The key is to define the order around its real use instead of treating every shirt request the same way.

ARK is based in Colorado Springs and serves Fountain and the surrounding south corridor. The quote form is the place to share the design, garment, quantity, print locations, deadline, and any durability or hand-feel priorities.

Local service without a made-up branch

Three Fountain apparel projects to clarify early

This page is for Fountain service requests. It does not claim a Fort Carson location, base access, military contract, or affiliation.

01 · EQUIP

Business and field apparel

Describe the working conditions, garment preferences, logo use, role variations, and reorder needs to create a dependable apparel program.

02 · GATHER

Events and group shirts

A group order becomes easier to quote when the date, artwork, quantity, sizing, print locations, and distribution plan are available together.

03 · INTRODUCE

Merchandise and promotion

For a branded product or campaign piece, include the intended audience, garment feel, design coverage, launch quantity, and visual goals.

Give the production plan enough context

What to send in a Fountain custom-apparel request

The correct print path depends on how the garments will be used, the artwork, the garment choice, and the amount of production required.

  • Artwork or logo and desired garment use
  • Garment type, color, and any durability needs
  • Quantity, size range, and possible reorder needs
  • Front, back, sleeve, or multiple placement details
  • Needed-by date and fulfillment notes

Quote-first workflow

How a Fountain order is scoped

  1. Send the project details through the quote form.
  2. ARK reviews the garment, art, quantity, and timeline requirements.
  3. The quote and proofing steps are set before production is scheduled.
  4. With approval, ARK produces the order in Colorado Springs and confirms fulfillment.

Choose the finish after the brief

Pick a process based on the garment’s job

A durable work piece, a vivid event shirt, a simple promo tee, and a detailed product graphic may need different methods. Screen printing, DTF, embroidery, water-based ink, and discharge are selected from the project brief rather than the city name.

Use the quote form to describe the project. These service pages can help you understand the production conversation before you submit it.
